## Summary
- P1 AgentSession GUI: lifecycle wiring into Win32 IDE agent run loop and tool shell.
- Covers session ownership, cancellation, and cleanup paths introduced on this branch.
- Kept separate from IDE product-path and ExtensionHost PRs until acceptance gates pass.

## Scope (this PR only)
- Validate AgentSession lifecycle, cancellation, and cleanup.
- Compile, link, launch, and exercise session start/stop/kill/restore/proof paths.
- Preserve frozen daily-driver baseline `A4F083DFΓÇª` (no regression).

## Explicit non-claims
- `PROMOTE=0`
- `CERTIFIED=0`
- Opening this PR does **not** authorize merge.
- Prior Finish-25 authority remains **19/25** until new SHA-specific evidence changes it.
- Do not inherit PASS results from another executable or from PR #77.
- 330 MB tip dumps and temporary generated files must stay out of Git.

## Test plan
- [ ] Clean build + link of Win32IDE from this branch tip
- [ ] Start agent session; verify ownership and state transitions
- [ ] Cancel in-flight work; confirm cleanup / no orphan threads or HWND use
- [ ] Kill / restore / proof paths exercise without false PASS
- [ ] Confirm no regression vs frozen baseline `A4F083DFΓÇª`
- [ ] Record SHA-specific evidence for this executable only
- [ ] Leave `PROMOTE=0` / `CERTIFIED=0` until independently validated

## Integration order
1. IDE Product Path (PR #77) ΓÇö separate gates
2. This PR (AgentSession GUI)
3. ExtensionHost Runtime (separate PR)
4. Only after all three merge + pass: unified full-feature candidate ΓåÆ Finish-25 ΓåÆ release audit
